decisions.label: Metastatic Neoplasm
decisions.description: A malignant tumor that has spread from its original site of growth to another anatomic location.

verification.note: NCIT:C3261 Metastatic Neoplasm; exact label match.

decisions.label: Not Applicable
decisions.description: Determination of a value is not relevant in the current context.

verification.note: NCIT:C48660 Not Applicable; standard NCIT qualifier.

decisions.label: Not Otherwise Specified
decisions.description: Not characterized in any other way.

verification.note: NCIT:C19594 Not Otherwise Specified; exact label match.
NCIT:C43234 Not Reported; standard NCIT qualifier.

decisions.label: Premalignant Condition
decisions.description: A lesion or cellular condition with the potential to develop into cancer.

verification.note: NCIT:C36032 Premalignant Condition; label uses 'Condition' vs 'Neoplasm' but is the standard NCIT term for pre-malignant lesions. Best available match.

decisions.label: Primary Neoplasm
decisions.description: A neoplasm at the original site of growth.

verification.note: NCIT:C8509 Primary Neoplasm; exact label match.

decisions.label: Recurrent Neoplasm
decisions.description: A lesion that has reappeared at the original site of a neoplasm after a period of remission.

verification.note: NCIT:C4798 Recurrent Neoplasm; exact label match.

decisions.label: Unknown
decisions.description: Not known, observed, recorded, or reported as unknown by the data contributor.

decisions.label: Cell Line-Derived Xenograft
decisions.description: A biospecimen derived from the culturing of a derived cell line in a non-human organism.

verification.note: NCIT:C156443 Cell Line-Derived Xenograft; label is more specific than the plain 'Xenograft' term, but this is the only NCIT biospecimen-class xenograft term and correctly falls under the Biospecimen hierarchy. Flag for review — a more generic 'Xenograft' biospecimen term may exist.
